summary: This iteration reruns the study as a dependent of research iteration 7, which aligned research/interpretations.md with the study for STU-020; no blocking finding was forwarded to this stage. The study was checked against the revised record on every point STU-020 named and agrees with it. The revised record's section 4.3 now forbids reporting Ambrose at Exp. in Lc. V.15 as judging the crowd 'in the same way' as Chrysostom. In V.15 the fearers are unbelievers and calumniators; the wording was checked in the tracked transcription, SHA-256 fde2303a verified. Standing advisory STU-022 is also cleared: the Gradual's Sextuplex placings now match research/scope.md section 2.3 (four books, with the Introit in three). The generation timestamp and contribution record and research/production-review.md are updated. The manifest was unchanged.
